name: Worktree Load
description: CPU, RAM, agents, git diff and disk size of every worktree Orca created, in the status bar and a sidebar panel. Notifies when one stays heavy.

commands.title: Worktree Load: refresh and show the heaviest worktree

settings.title: Poll every (seconds)
settings.description: How often to read CPU and RAM per worktree.

settings.title: Heavy CPU (% of one core)
settings.description: A worktree above this is flagged.

settings.title: Heavy RAM (MB)
settings.description: A worktree above this is flagged; twice this turns the status bar red.

settings.title: Notify when a worktree stays heavy
settings.description: After 3 polls in a row over a threshold.

settings.title: Disk scan every (minutes)
settings.description: Runs du on every worktree. 0 turns it off.
